raw_segments.text: Then, if a person were to remark that a is taller by a head than b, and b less by a head
than a, you would refuse to admit his statement, and would stoutly contend that what you mean
is only that the greater is greater by, and by reason of greatness, and the less is less
only by, and by reason of smallness.
And thus you would avoid the danger of saying that the greater is greater and the less less
by the measure of the head, which is the same in both, and would also avoid the monstrous
absurdity of supposing that the greater man is greater by reason of the head, which is
You would be afraid to draw such an inference, would you not?
